The page says the runtime loads at construction, so a load failure most likely surfaces then. Either the constructor throws, or it records the failure and each execute() rejects with the same controlled error. I lean toward the constructor not throwing and both calls rejecting with the cached error, with no second load attempt.

(a) ping: protocol version only. (b) stop: protocol, instance id and token. (c) execute: all three. (d) result-fetch: all three. (e) terminate: all three. Control requests have exceptions, so ping skips the instance/token checks.
